name: Hillsbrad Foothills
summary: Hillsbrad Foothills is a green, fertile region that represents the last pastoral bastion of the fallen kingdom of Lordaeron. Despite having largely escaped the Scourge's plague, the land is torn apart by brutal open war between the humans of Southshore and the Forsaken entrenched at Tarren Mill. It serves as a violent crossroads where the armies of the Alliance and the Horde clash without mercy.

sections.title: A Garden Beside the Ruins
sections.body: While northern Lordaeron rots under the blight of the Scourge, Hillsbrad remains strikingly green. Its rolling pastures, pine groves, and working farmsteads offer travelers a rare glimpse of what the kingdom looked like before the Third War. Yet that tranquil appearance is deceptive. The peaceful fields and rural roads are constantly swept by armed patrols, rogue mercenaries, and scavenger beasts. What should be Lordaeron's breadbasket has instead become its most contested borderland.

sections.title: The War of Southshore and Tarren Mill
sections.body: The political heart of Hillsbrad is defined by two entrenched strongholds. In the south along the coast lies Southshore, an Alliance haven populated by human refugees and soldiers fiercely loyal to the Alliance. To the north sits Tarren Mill, once a quiet human farming hamlet that was wiped out by the Scourge and later fortified as the Forsaken's southernmost garrison. The open ground between the two settlements is known throughout Azeroth as a relentless kill zone, where Alliance and Horde champions wage perpetual skirmishes for control of the region.

sections.title: Old Scars and Hidden Threats
sections.body: Hillsbrad's history of violence runs deep. During the Second War, its coast and hills witnessed the first massive clashes between the Grand Alliance and the Old Horde. Later, the fortress of Durnholde Keep served as the internment camp where Thrall was raised before leading the orcish rebellion. Today, Durnholde lies in ruins, seized by the Syndicate—displaced human nobles turned bandit cutthroats. Coastal murlocs, hostile gnolls, and the shadowed dead on Purgation Isle ensure that no corner of the hills is truly secure.

faq.q: Why isn't Hillsbrad blighted like the rest of Lordaeron?
faq.answer: The Scourge marched primarily along the central corridors toward the capital and the northern kingdoms, leaving Hillsbrad largely bypassed by the plague cauldrons that ruined the north. As a result, the soil remains fertile and the vegetation healthy, making it the most pristine remnant of old Lordaeron.

Neither faction holds full control. The Alliance maintains Southshore and nearby farms like the Hillsbrad Fields, while the Forsaken hold Tarren Mill to the north. Dwarven forces hold the fortress of Dun Garok in the east, and the criminal Syndicate occupies the ruins of Durnholde Keep.

Durnholde was once the headquarters of the Alliance internment camp system after the Second War, governed by Aedelas Blackmoore, who raised Thrall there as a gladiator slave. Thrall escaped, rallied the orcs, and laid waste to the keep. In the aftermath of Lordaeron's fall, the ruins were occupied by the Syndicate.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken and humans fight so fiercely here?
faq.answer: Tarren Mill represents the southern frontier of Sylvanas Windrunner's domain, while Southshore is the Alliance's primary staging ground and port into Lordaeron. The Forsaken view Southshore as an existential threat to their southern flank, while the humans view the undead as horrific usurpers who must be driven from their homeland.

Purgation Isle is an isolated, rugged island off the southern coast of Hillsbrad. Unlike the mainland hills, the island is infested with powerful undead ghouls, skeletons, and vengeful spirits, making it an extremely dangerous offshore haven for dark magic and restless dead.

faq.q: Who are the bandits occupying the camps and towers?
faq.answer: They belong to the Syndicate, an organized network of former nobility and foot soldiers from the fallen human kingdom of Alterac. Cast out for their kingdom's betrayal during the Second War, they now operate as ruthless bandits seeking to reclaim their lands through blackmail, theft, and slaughter.

angles.text: Southshore is one of your people's final refuges in Lordaeron; walking these pastures is a painful reminder of the great kingdom that was lost to betrayal and undeath.
Tarren Mill anchors the southern frontier of the Forsaken realm, where Apothecary Lydon works tirelessly to develop the New Plague to secure your people's future.
This soil holds monumental weight for your people: the ruined ramparts of Durnholde Keep are where Warchief Thrall broke his chains and reawakened the spirit of the Horde.
The soldiers of Dun Garok represent Ironforge's resolute military commitment to defending their human allies and containing the undead threat north of the Wetlands.
Hidden high in the mountains above the foothills lies Ravenholdt Manor, the secretive gathering place and training ground for Azeroth's most elite guild of thieves and assassins.
